info.description: Captured by the /contact form. Public role has `create` only.

phone.description: Optional. The form offers it but never requires it — a visitor who only wants email back leaves it empty.

subject.description: One of the enquiry types the form offers; see SUBJECTS in the controller, which is the allowlist. Anything else is stored as General Enquiry. Older rows may carry the retired Inquiry/Press wording.
